10 MHz 以上（20m、15m、10m 等）惯例使用 USB（上边带）。: Above 10 MHz (20 m, 15 m, 10 m, etc.) the convention is USB (upper sideband).
10 MHz 以下（80m、40m 等）惯例使用 LSB（下边带）。: Below 10 MHz (80 m, 40 m, etc.) the convention is LSB (lower sideband).
10MHz 以下也不例外；PSK31 多数软件默认 USB，但 40m 及以下仍: including below 10 MHz; most PSK31 software defaults to USB, but the LSB convention still holds on 40 m and below;
HF 话音通信主力: The mainstay of HF voice communication
SSTV / RTTY 等仍按所在波段的 LSB / USB 惯例。: and SSTV / RTTY still follow the LSB / USB convention of the band they are on.
VHF/UHF 及 60m、30m 等特殊波段统一使用 USB。: VHF/UHF and special bands such as 60 m and 30 m use USB throughout.
功率利用率高，典型话音（单边带）条件下约为 AM 的 4 倍（经验值，随调制深度: High power efficiency: under typical voice conditions it is about four times that of AM (an empirical figure that varies with modulation depth).
可在 SSB 带宽内传图。: Can send pictures within an SSB bandwidth.
带宽极窄、能量集中，弱信号下仍可抄收，穿透力强。: Extremely narrow bandwidth with concentrated energy: still copyable under weak signal and highly penetrating.
抑制载波与一个边带，只传一个边带（USB / LSB）。: Suppresses the carrier and one sideband, transmitting only one (USB / LSB).
数据模式不能一概说「不使用边带约定」—— FT8 / FT4 / JS8 / W: data modes cannot simply be said to "ignore the sideband convention" — WSJT-X family modes such as FT8 / FT4 / JS8 / WSPR use USB on every band,
用语音信道传输静止图像。: Transmits still images over a voice channel.
离散编码，弱信号解码能力强、带宽窄，适合数据与远距离。: Discrete coding, with strong decoding of weak signals and narrow bandwidth; suited to data and long distances.
载波加两个边带，设备简单。: Carrier plus two sidebands, with simple equipment.
边带约定只针对话音类模式。CW 无上下边带之分，工作在载波频率附近（靠音频差拍听: The sideband convention applies only to voice modes. CW has no upper or lower sideband and operates near the carrier frequency (heard as an audio beat tone);
远距离 DX、弱信号、应急通信: Long-distance DX, weak signals, emergency communication
连续波形承载信息，设备简单、话音自然，但抗噪声相对弱。: Information is carried by a continuous waveform; equipment is simple and speech sounds natural, but resistance to noise is relatively weak.
键控载波通断，用莫尔斯电码通信。: The carrier is keyed on and off to communicate in Morse code.
音质好、有捕获效应，强信号压制弱信号。: Good audio quality with a capture effect: a strong signal suppresses a weak one.
音质好、解调简单。: Good audio quality and simple demodulation.
频率调制，抗干扰能力强。: Frequency modulation, with strong resistance to interference.
